page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8ise.12xlarge is an x86_64 general-purpose compute instance within the Enhanced family, hosted on the KVM hypervisor. Hardware resources include 48 dedicated vCPUs backed by an Intel Xeon 8475B processor running at a base clock frequency of 2.7 GHz. System memory totals 192.0 GB, maintaining a balanced 1:4 core-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU.

The configuration provides zero onboard local storage, requiring network-attached storage for operating systems and persistent data. Graphical acceleration is absent, with zero GPUs installed. Network interfaces support a baseline bandwidth of 25 Gbps to sustain high-throughput data exchanges, and the instance is provisioned with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

By omitting integrated local storage disks and discrete GPUs, the instance focuses expenditure strictly on core compute density and networking capability. This structure makes the ecs.g8ise.12xlarge suitable for scalable enterprise applications, container orchestration clusters, distributed CI/CD build pipelines, and multi-tier backend web serving.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8ise.12xlarge is an x86_64 general-purpose instance from the Enhanced family powered by the KVM hypervisor. It contains no onboard local storage or GPU hardware, relying on network-attached block volumes for data persistence. Network capabilities include a 25 Gbps baseline bandwidth, providing high-capacity interconnectivity across distributed environments without bundled complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The balanced ratio of processing cores to memory capacity delivers consistent execution capacity without paying for idle hardware accelerators. This configuration is engineered for scalable enterprise applications, container orchestration nodes, backend web servers, batch processing jobs, and distributed CI/CD build clusters.
